worker_provenance_note: The script changed from 082efd69 to bb25789d during the run; the 21 earliest measurements and three failed workers carry no worker_sha256. The edit changed only the qubit-resonator initial state, the uncompiled evolve() path and summary code, and every measurement it affects was requested after it.

summary.step_count_note: Accepted step counts give average interval step size, not the largest actual step. A correlation alone does not prove the mechanism.
summary.method_note: Forward uses jacfwd; default BackwardCheckpointed is a repeat of the existing adjoint. Expm is measured through mesolve, which exponentiates a D²-dimensional Liouvillian even with no collapse operators.
summary.scope_note: Scan changes only the interval-valued branch and retains one mesolve and max_steps per interval. Scalar controls retain one whole-window solve. All timings synchronize outputs. Double precision is initialized before tracing both variants. Plain-call compile logs are retained.

1_reproduction.scope: Both populations are real scalar objectives differentiated with value_and_grad. Initial states have equal populations and relative phase pi/4 on levels (0,1) or (1,2); open transmons use adjacent-level relaxation at 0.03/ns. Lab finite differences inspect four declared coordinates; rotating cases inspect every coordinate.

4_scan.restart: A separate dq.mesolve call in each scan iteration starts from the preceding density matrix and receives the original per-solve max_steps. Scalar controls retain a single whole-window solve.
